name: Deep Learning 5 — Practice Lab (Autoencoder and ECG Anomaly Detection)
description: Guided learner workspace for the fifth lab of a Deep Learning course (2×45 min), 1.1 edition, on CPU. The topic is the autoencoder and ECG-based anomaly detection; the learner interprets the observed result and changes one setting at a time. Programs: environment check (local data, CPU, figure saving); normal and anomalous ECG waveform (G05_01); real autoencoder training and reconstruction (G05_02); per-signal MAE and the distribution of the errors (G05_03); the effect of the decision threshold on alerts and mistaken decisions, precision/recall (G05_04). G05_03 and G05_04 always use the bundled 30-epoch reference reconstructions built with an eight-value bottleneck, not the learner's latest model. Every run creates its own short, numbered subfolder under view (figures and result.json). The lab closes with ten fixed, explanatory questions. The package also contains the instructor/ material (setup, answer key, measured verified runs, sample figures); run with the Run button, everything runs locally without GPU and internet, no homework. CNNs belong to the next practice.
